title: LeftJoin1_version_1
code:
SELECT Customers.CustomerName, Orders.OrderID
FROM Customers
LEFT JOIN Orders ON Customers.CustomerID = Orders.CustomerID

lines.code:
FROM Customers
LEFT JOIN Orders ON Customers.CustomerID = Orders.CustomerID
lines.explanation: The LEFT JOIN keyword returns all records from the left table (Customers), even if there are no matches in the right table (Orders). This returns the list of all customers' orders. However, in contrast to INNER JOIN, which will not show customers without orders, LEFT JOIN will show those customers and NULL in their orders-related columns.
